notes_for_editor: The only source for this tower is one row of the Firetowers of Saskatchewan list: a name and a position. Its height field holds only a stray letter ('L') and the year, towermen and notes fields are blank, so none of them is used. No source read gives a build date, design, agency, staffing or current status. The Komoot trail is a hiking guide, used for access only; nothing read ties the Fire Tower Trail to this tower. The park is described (Wikipedia) as 14 km east of Kamsack, stretching east to the Manitoba boundary; the record point may fall within that extent but was not checked on a map. Do not merge with Madge Lake (Duck Mountain Provincial Park, SK; a 1951 annual report says its fire tower was repaired), which is a separate record. The Manitoba Baldy Mountain and Duck Mountain Forest Reserve pages on canada-lookouts.weebly.com are also separate. AllTrails returned HTTP 403. Used 2 searches and about 5 page reads.
